Available on npm."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-workspace-recent-sort"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"npm: <https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-workspace-recent-sort>
Repository: <https://github.com/easyc"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"hen/dsh-workspace-recent-sort>"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness sidebar plugin with three related behaviors:"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"1. **WorkSpace groups follow “Last updated”** — a Workspace with a newer
conversation rises to the t"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"op of the sidebar.
2. **Compact Workspace conversations** — an expanded Workspace shows only its
new"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"est conversation; hovering reveals the next few with an animation.
3. **Scroll back after a reorder*"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"* — when the automatic ordering moves groups,
the sidebar scrolls the currently selected conversatio"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"matic ordering moves groups,
the sidebar scrolls the currently selected conversation back into view."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"The ordering and compact-display behaviors have switches in
**Settings → 工作区 / Workspaces**."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## The problem"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"DSH's native **Order by → Last updated** sorts Sessions *inside* each
Workspace. Workspace groups th"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"emselves always render in the Host's durable
`workspaceIds` order (the order produced by dragging fo"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"lders). A Workspace with
a brand-new conversation therefore stays wherever it was manually placed."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"This plugin leaves that durable order untouched. It only changes the browser
projection while, and o"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"nly while, both of these are selected:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- **Group by** = **WorkSpace** (按工作区)
- **Order by** = **Last updated** (最近更新)"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Behavior"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### Recent ordering"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- Workspace groups are ordered by the newest `updatedAt` among their real
conversations, newest firs"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"t. Archived conversations still count; a visible
archived row is a real conversation.
- Provisional "},{"id":"p13s3","text":"blank Sessions (the "New Session" placeholder) and hidden
subagent children do not count as conversa"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"tion activity.
- Workspaces with no loaded conversation fall to the bottom. Ties keep the
Host's rel"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"ative order, so the result is deterministic.
- Switching to **Manual** order (手动排序), **Workspace Tre"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"e** (按工作区树), or
the flat list restores the native order immediately.
- No Host state is written: the"},{"id":"p13s7","text":" durable Workspace order is unchanged, no
Session is moved, and there is no network request. Workspa"},{"id":"p13s8","text":"ce drag commits are
suppressed while **Last updated** is active, because a durable reorder would
be "},{"id":"p13s9","text":"invisible under the recency projection; switch to **Manual** to arrange
folders.
- The plugin only w"},{"id":"p13s10","text":"raps the sidebar's registered `WorkspaceBrowser`. The
Workspace picker, search results, session rows"},{"id":"p13s11","text":", archive filters, pins, and
session drag behavior remain native."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### Compact conversations"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- In **Group by → WorkSpace**, an expanded Workspace shows only its newest
conversation row by defau"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"lt, plus any row that must stay actionable.
- Hovering the Workspace header or its visible row anima"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"tes the next three
conversations into view (the newest conversation plus three more; a
provisional N"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"ew Session row stays visible when present). Moving away collapses
them again.
- The currently select"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"ed conversation stays visible even when it is not the
newest one.
- Rows with a running turn, a runn"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"ing subagent child, or a pending interaction
(approval / plan review / question) are never hidden by"},{"id":"p15s7","text":" compact mode, even
when several of them run at once.
- The **展开其余 xx 个会话 / Show remaining … convers"},{"id":"p15s8","text":"ations** button stays
hidden until the Workspace is hovered or keyboard-focused.
- Keyboard focus in"},{"id":"p15s9","text":"side a Workspace expands all of its rendered rows. Clicking
**展开其余 xx 个会话 / Show remaining … convers"},{"id":"p15s10","text":"ations** raises the native
watermark for that Workspace; once more than six rows are rendered, hover"},{"id":"p15s11","text":"ing
reveals all of them.
- Collapsed Workspaces, Workspace Tree mode, and the flat list keep their
n"},{"id":"p15s12","text":" of them.
- Collapsed Workspaces, Workspace Tree mode, and the flat list keep their
native behavior."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### Scroll to the selected conversation"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"After any Workspace reorder changes the group order — the automatic recent
ordering, a sort-mode swi"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"tch, or a manual workspace drag — the plugin scrolls
the sidebar so the currently selected conversat"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"ion is visible. If the row is
already visible, `block: "nearest"` leaves the scroll position alone."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Settings"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"**Settings → 工作区 / Workspaces** provides two switches:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| Switch | Default | Effect |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| 按最近更新排序工作区 | On | Enable the recent-ordering projection. |
| 工作区对话简约显示 | On | Enable the one-row c"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"ompact display and hover reveal. |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Settings are browser-local (`dsh.workspace-recent-sort.settings.v1` in
`localStorage`), so different"},{"id":"p22s2","text":" browsers can use different preferences. Toggles
apply immediately without a reload."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Install the published bundle from npm into the Web profile:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Or install directly from GitHub:"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so it installs as an active profile
bundle. Restart `dsh we"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"b` if requested and refresh the Web page."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"For local development, link the checkout instead:"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Then make sure `dsh-workspace-recent-sort` is present in
`dsh.profile.bundles` in the profile's `pac"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"ure `dsh-workspace-recent-sort` is present in
`dsh.profile.bundles` in the profile's `package.json`."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"To remove it:"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"The Plugins page / bundle installer offers the same install and removal
operations."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"Built against DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`. The native View-options menu has no public
extension slot for group "},{"id":"p36s2","text":"ordering, so the plugin uses the sidebar
registration's own component seam: it replaces `entry.compo"},{"id":"p36s3","text":"nent` with a wrapper
that preserves the entry's store, injected services, locale, and child-slot
aut"},{"id":"p36s4","text":"horization. Compact mode is CSS scoped under a data attribute and targets
structural `data-row-key` "},{"id":"p36s5","text":"attributes rather than hashed class names. If the
sidebar shape is not recognized, the plugin leaves"},{"id":"p36s6","text":" the native component
untouched rather than failing application boot."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"The browser bundle is hand-written against the DSH module loader, so no build
step is required."},{"id":"p40s1","text":"Maintainers: see PUBLISHING.md for the npm release checklist."}],"truncated":false}
